## Type of change

- [ ] New component (minor)
- [ ] New optional prop / token (minor)
- [ ] Fix, no API change (patch)
- [ ] Breaking: prop removed/renamed/changed, deprecated API deleted (major)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Changeset added (`npm run changeset`) when `src/` changed
- [ ] Props have JSDoc; no `any`; no hard-coded colors or sizes (tokens via `useTheme`)
- [ ] Story covers every variant and state (default, pressed, disabled, loading, error)
- [ ] Tests: render, press, disabled
- [ ] Accessibility: `accessibilityRole`, `accessibilityLabel`, `accessibilityState`
- [ ] Visual matches Figma (screenshots below) or the difference is agreed with the owner
- [ ] Deprecations use `@deprecated` + dev warning; nothing removed outside a major
